items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I went over there with Mezzrow... We had Jimmy Archey, myself, Pops Foster, Mezzrow, Lee Collins... And Mezzrow could transport [sic] all we didn't understand... Mezzrow would transport [sic] it, you know, from him to us.

ctx.x: So that was a pretty extensive tour. That tour lasted what, about six months?
Well, both of them together... See, I went over there with Mezzrow, the first one. I went back with Sammy
